packageRules.description: Dependabot owns the Go module dependencies (#660: two updaters on gomod produced racing duplicate PRs). Dependabot does not update the toolchain directive (dependabot-core#13520), so nobody bumped it after the gomod manager was switched off on 2026-08-26. Renovate therefore handles only the go and toolchain directives (datasource golang-version) and leaves the module dependencies (datasource go) to Dependabot.
Disable gofiber major updates - requires manual code migration
